title: Executed double command
purpose: Exercise the double-command path with a different TypeID, address, common address, and command qualifier from the single-command seed.
expected_behavior: The peer parses a TypeID 46 double command addressed to information-object address 2, with ON state and execute mode.
constraints_preserved: The double-command state is ON and the select/execute bit is execute
The I-format length 0x0e equals four APCI control bytes plus the 10-byte ASDU
Common address 2 and information-object address 2 remain internally consistent
issue_safety_notes: Safe valid structural coverage with bounded values; no malformed framing or historical exploit bytes are included.
